title: Newton's laws of motion Module 2 Lesson 1: Smooth Inclined Plane custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values, and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

questions.prompt: A particle of mass $4\text{ kg}$ is released from rest on a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Calculate the acceleration of the particle down the plane, and state the normal reaction force $R$ exerted by the plane on the particle. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the particle down the plane, and state the normal reaction force $R$ exerted by the plane on the particle. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

questions.prompt: A block of mass $5\text{ kg}$ is pulled up a smooth plane inclined at $20^\circ$ to the horizontal by a force $P$ acting parallel to the plane. Given that the block moves up the plane with an acceleration of $1.5\text{ m s}^{-2}$, calculate the magnitude of $P$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the pulling force $P$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

questions.prompt: A particle is released from rest on a smooth plane inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal. In the first $3.0\text{ s}$ of motion, the particle slides a distance of $18.0\text{ m}$ down the plane along a line of greatest slope. Calculate the angle $\theta$ in degrees to 1 decimal place. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.prompt: Calculate the angle $\theta$ in degrees to 1 decimal place. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

questions.prompt: A crate of mass $12\text{ kg}$ rests on a smooth plane inclined at $35^\circ$ to the horizontal. A force of magnitude $60\text{ N}$ is applied parallel to and down the plane. Calculate the acceleration of the crate down the plane. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the crate down the plane. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

questions.prompt: A particle of mass $6\text{ kg}$ is held on a smooth plane inclined at $40^\circ$ to the horizontal by a force $F$ acting at an angle of $25^\circ$ above the plane. If the particle accelerates up the line of greatest slope at $0.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$, calculate the magnitude of $F$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of $F$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

questions.prompt: A particle is projected up a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal with an initial speed of $12\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Determine the time taken for the particle to reach its highest point along the plane, and the distance it travels up the plane before instantaneously coming to rest. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.prompt: Determine the time taken to reach the highest point and the distance traveled up the plane. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

questions.prompt: A smooth slope of length $12.5\text{ m}$ is inclined at $\alpha$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\alpha = 0.28$. A small toy sledge of mass $3.5\text{ kg}$ is released from rest at the top of the slope. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of the sledge down the slope is $2.8\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and calculate the normal reaction force exerted by the slope on the sledge.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the speed of the sledge as it reaches the bottom of the slope, and the time taken for this descent.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $8\text{ kg}$ is held at rest on a smooth plane inclined at $25^\circ$ to the horizontal. A light rope attached to the block pulls it directly up the line of greatest slope with a constant tension $T$. The block moves from rest and covers a distance of $9.0\text{ m}$ up the plane in $3.0\text{ s}$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of the block up the plane is $2.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: By applying Newton's second law along the plane, calculate the tension $T$ in the rope, and find the normal reaction force $R$ between the plane and the block.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ of mass $2.0\text{ kg}$ is projected from the bottom of a smooth plane inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.60$. The initial speed of projection up the line of greatest slope is $15.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the deceleration of $P$ while moving up the plane, and calculate the maximum distance $d$ traveled up the plane before $P$ comes instantaneously to rest.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Determine the total time elapsed from the instant of projection until $P$ returns to its starting point at the bottom of the plane.

questions.prompt: A package of mass $15\text{ kg}$ is pulled up a smooth ramp inclined at $22^\circ$ to the horizontal by a cable making an angle of $18^\circ$ above the surface of the ramp. The tension in the cable is $110\text{ N}$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the normal contact force exerted by the ramp on the package, and verify that the package does not lose contact with the ramp.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the package up the ramp, and determine its speed after being pulled for $4.0\text{ s}$ from rest.

questions.prompt: A trolley of mass $50\text{ kg}$ is held on a smooth inclined runway whose angle of inclination is $\beta$, where $\tan\beta = \frac{5}{12}$. A constant force $F$ acts on the trolley directed up the line of greatest slope. Starting from rest, the trolley accelerates up the runway, reaching a speed of $6.0\text{ m s}^{-1}$ after traveling a distance of $9.0\text{ m}$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: State the exact values of $\sin\beta$ and $\cos\beta$, and show that the acceleration of the trolley up the runway is $2.0\text{ m s}^{-2}$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the driving force $F$, and find the normal reaction force exerted on the trolley by the runway.

questions.prompt: A particle $B$ of mass $0.6\text{ kg}$ is released from rest at a point $X$ on a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. It slides down the line of greatest slope for $2.0\text{ s}$ until it reaches a point $Y$, where it instantaneously moves onto a smooth horizontal surface that is flush and continuous with the plane. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of $B$ down the plane, the distance $XY$, and the speed of $B$ when it reaches $Y$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Upon reaching $Y$, a constant retarding force of $1.5\text{ N}$ is applied horizontally to $B$ opposing its motion. Calculate the deceleration of $B$ on the horizontal surface, and the distance $B$ travels along the horizontal surface before coming to rest at point $Z$.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Determine the total time taken for the entire journey from $X$ to $Z$.

questions.prompt: A block of mass $4.0\text{ kg}$ is initially at rest at the foot $O$ of a long smooth plane inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = \frac{3}{5}$ and $\cos\theta = \frac{4}{5}$. A force $P$ of magnitude $64.0\text{ N}$ parallel to the plane acts up the plane on the block for a distance of $5.0\text{ m}$. At this instant, the force $P$ is suddenly removed, and the block continues to move up the plane under gravity alone until it comes to instantaneous rest at point $M$, after which it slides back down the plane to $O$. (Take $g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}$.)

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the block while the force $P$ is acting, and calculate its speed and the time taken when it has moved $5.0\text{ m}$ from $O$.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the further distance the block travels up the plane after $P$ is removed before reaching $M$, and state the total distance $OM$.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Calculate the speed with which the block returns to $O$, and the total time elapsed from the initial departure from $O$ until the block returns to $O$.
